cohort: The study included 75 women recovering from preeclampsia, with a median age of 29 years, comprising both HIV-positive women on ART and HIV-negative women.
finding: Women living with HIV on ART had significantly higher levels of hs-CRP and an increased risk of presenting as hypertensive with elevated hs-CRP at six weeks postpartum compared to HIV-negative women recovering from preeclampsia.
